howItWorks.heading: How InsightLoop Operates
howItWorks.subheading: A transparent, robust architecture designed to turn unstructured attendee reactions into verified institutional improvements.

step1.title: Host Creates Event & Configures Form
step1.desc: An organizer registers their college, club, or enterprise account and defines event sessions. Using the Dynamic Form Builder or 1-click AI form generation, they select rating scales, NPS, multiple-choice questions, and enable voice feedback.

step2.title: Instant QR Code & Link Generation
step2.desc: InsightLoop generates a high-resolution QR code and printable feedback badge flyer. Organizers project the QR on stage screens or print it on attendee badges for seamless mobile scanning.

step3.title: Multilingual Participant Submission
step3.desc: Attendees scan the QR code and are directed to the mobile-optimized form without being forced to create an account. They choose English, Hindi, or Marathi, submit text or record audio, review transcriptions, and submit anonymously or identified.

step4.title: Bhashini Pipeline & AI Intelligence
step4.desc: Multilingual text and speech are processed via Bhashini translation (NMT) and speech-to-text (ASR). Our AI service runs sentiment analysis, extracts recurring complaints, clusters topics, and creates actionable recommendations with evidence.

step5.title: Continuous Tracking & Benchmark Reporting
step5.desc: Organizers review interactive Recharts dashboards, query the RAG AI Assistant for natural language answers, convert recommendations into team tasks, and export executive PDF or Excel reports.
